title: ML and ASR are assessment layers
summary: ML-ready material records source interval, representation and processing lineage separately from runtime binding. ASR segmentation is itself an uncertain assessment before lexical transcription.
invariants: Do not feed arbitrary quiet/noisy fixed chunks to a language-model-heavy ASR and treat fluent output as acoustic truth.
ASR results are candidate transcript boundaries, not invented lexical confidence.
Speaker embeddings, ASR, pitch and music fingerprint outputs retain model/runtime provenance.
Resident Python sequences should be traversed through ForeignPython collection proxies and Rexxified only at persistent evidence boundaries.

provenance.claim: ASR segmentation/preparation and candidate transcript doctrine.
